verdict.rationale: Docs show account linking via Connect (docs-27) feeds multiple products—verification/account ownership, balances, transactions, ACH details—implying a shared linked-account model rather than per-product re-auth, but no explicit statement that a single Connect/link session simultaneously authorizes and returns auth+balances+transactions+identity without separate flows. missing for 10: explicit documentation confirming one link session grants access to all data products at once, developer walkthrough or hands-on evidence showing multi-product access from a single Connect session, and clarification on whether each product still requires separate permissioning/re-consent.
